description: Karakeep (formerly Hoarder) is a self-hosted bookmark-everything app — save links, notes, and images with automatic tagging and full-text/AI-assisted search. A more actively developed alternative to the Shiori/linkding templates in this list.

env.description: Random secret, generate with: openssl rand -base64 36
env.label: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
env.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET

env.description: Optional: URL of an external Meilisearch instance to enable full-text search, e.g. http://meilisearch:7700
env.label: MEILI_ADDR
env.name: MEILI_ADDR

name: karakeep
note: Runs standalone without Meilisearch or a headless Chrome sidecar, but full-text search and screenshot capture will be disabled until those are configured — see the official docker-compose.yml for the full stack.
title: Karakeep
